source: Hand-maintained beside upcoming.json. Meeting dates are the 2026 City Council meeting start dates in Deme's published record (data/index-2026.json, body "City Council"). Schedule re-checked against TMMIS on November 18, 2026: the first meeting of the new term is Wednesday, November 18, 2026, with 24 published City Council items (2027.CC1.1-CC1.7, 2027.BL1.1, and the first-meeting and routine-morning items), so firstNewTermMeetingDate is set to 2026-11-18 and the date joins meetingDates.
